title: Launch Pad: Model Rollout Coordination & Release Notes Sequence
creator: Ava Patel
description: Purpose: Provide an executable, time-ordered checklist and communications sequence for adding a new model to the public catalog. Scope includes catalog entry content, benchmark publication, docs updates, SDK examples, release notes cadence, marketing/comm sync, and post-launch monitoring playbook. Goals: (1) Ensure every launch has a reproducible release-notes artifact and announcement kit; (2) Minimize runbook gaps between PM/Eng/Design/GTM; (3) Define gating criteria so launches are blocked only for high-severity issues.
